exposure: Mode of delivery (water birth vs. bed birth)
oxytocin use in first stage of labor
oxytocin use in second stage of labor
Oxytocin use in first and second stage of labor
outcome: Rate of obstetric anal sphincter injuries
cohort: 3907 primiparae who gave birth at a Swiss teaching hospital
finding: Primiparae who had a water birth had a lower risk of obstetric anal sphincter injuries compared to those who had a bed birth.
mod_finding: The rate of obstetric anal sphincter injuries was significantly lower in water births compared to bed births among those who received oxytocin in the first and second stage of labor.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not reported
